premises.text: Outdoor maintenance equipment is gasoline/diesel powered and faces a long-term labor shortage
premises.evidence_span: traditional equipment is gasoline or diesel powered, and there's a long-term labor shortage

premises.text: After solar plants are built, vegetation cutting is the biggest ongoing expense
premises.evidence_span: after a solar power plant is built, the biggest expense is actually cutting the vegetation and the grass on site

premises.text: Solar sites need equipment that fits under panels around I-beams plus a special rough-cut deck for thick vegetation
premises.evidence_span: drive lines limit typical equipment, and that equipment needs to go underneath the panels and around the I-beams

premises.text: A modular electric robot platform supports grass cutting, snow plowing, and many other outdoor operations via attachments
premises.evidence_span: We've developed a powerful modular platform for not just grass cutting and snow plowing, but dozens of different operations

premises.text: Quick-attach tops and five-minute battery swaps enable many use cases and near 24/7 operation
premises.evidence_span: Our quick attach system makes switching attachments quick and easy

premises.text: World's first 100% electric rough-cut deck cuts thick solar-site vegetation
premises.evidence_span: we've developed the world's first 100% electric rough cut deck that is especially made to cut down that thick vegetation that grows on solar sites

premises.text: Offset electric grass-cutting deck reaches up to six feet under panels and around I-beams
premises.evidence_span: 100% electric grass-cutting deck that is able to offset, and it can offset up to six feet to get underneath those panels and around those I-beams

premises.text: Solar vegetation cutting is the launch use case in a much larger outdoor work robotics market
premises.evidence_span: the solar vegetation cuts market globally by 24 alone is expected to be $50 billion
